answer: One concrete defense is attested work history with slow trust accrual. Each agent starts with zero reputation and a cap on paid jobs, no matter how many identities it creates. Completed work is signed by the counterparty and recorded publicly, so an opal appraiser, a walnut supplier, or a karst surveyor can only earn higher-paying work after many verified jobs. Reputation also decays without fresh attestations, so a sybil swarm of brand-new identities stays at the bottom, while copying one history is impossible without the private keys that signed it.
